parameters.content:
## ① Run this once

Click the **Create KB Table** node → *Test step*.

It creates a data table called `qa_knowledge_base` — the bot's memory. It starts empty and fills itself as questions get answered.

You can browse and edit it any time under **Data tables** in the left sidebar. Fixing a wrong answer there fixes it for everyone who asks next.

## ② How it connects

No webhook, no tunnel, nothing on this machine is exposed to the internet. n8n **asks** Telegram for new messages every 30 seconds (long-polling, so a reply normally lands in about a second).

**n8n must be started like this:**
```
N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false \
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=123456:AA... \
n8n start
```
The token lives in the environment, never inside this workflow.

## ③ How to ask

The bot answers when it is **spoken to directly**:
• `/ask your question`
• `@nexushelper421bot your question`
• replying to one of its own answers
• a photo sent with `/ask` in the caption

Telegram delivers exactly these three to a bot even with **privacy mode ON**, so nothing needs changing in BotFather — and the bot never receives ordinary group conversation.

**Want it to answer bare questions too?** Make the bot a group admin (or `/setprivacy` → Disable + re-add it), then set `ANSWER_ANY_QUESTION = true` at the top of **Normalize Message**.

## ④ Photos

A member can photograph an assessment question and send it. The largest resolution is downloaded and passed to a vision model.

⚠️ Images over ~175 KB can't be inlined into NVIDIA's API, so those fall back to answering from the caption.

## ⑤ Memory first, AI second

Every stored question is compared to the new one: exact match wins, otherwise keyword overlap must beat **0.62**.

Hit → the stored answer is sent, no API call, instant and free.
Miss → Nemotron answers, and the answer is saved so the *next* person gets it free.

Photos always skip the cache.

## ⑥ Answers can be any length

No word limit in the prompt (`max_tokens` 2048). Telegram caps a message at 4096 characters, so **Split Long Answer** breaks a long reply at paragraph boundaries and sends it as `(1/3)`, `(2/3)`, `(3/3)`.

Exam questions get the final answer first, then the working.

## ⑦ It teaches itself

After replying: a fresh AI answer is written into the data table, and a reused answer just bumps its `hits` counter — so you can see what your community keeps asking.
